messages:
alina: quick follow-up from the all-hands  a few rapid q's about the hiring redirect and timeline
marco: short answers up front: no total hiring freeze; prioritizing infra, SRE, and Dedicated capacity hires. more below.
alina: 1) will managers be able to continue interviews for non-priority reqs during the pause?
ryan: recruiting: you can finish interviews already in flight, but we won't extend new offers for paused reqs until reviews complete. recruiting will DM managers with status by EOD.
alina: 2) internal mobility window timing?
people-bot: Internal mobility window: Jul 11 - Jul 15. Apply via portal: https://intranet.redwood.com/mobility :link:
vp-people: mobility open Jul 11Jul 15. We encourage folks to talk to managers but formal sign-off isn't required to apply.
alina: 3) backfill priority if an IC moves teams mid-window?
marco: backfills for customer-impacting or SLA roles are first priority. submit a "critical-backfill" note in #hq-hiring with impact summary; aim for 72hr response.
ryan: noncritical backfills will be queued and reviewed in the Q3 budget pass.
alina: 4) leveling/regrade concerns for folks changing reporting lines?
vp-people: we'll run fast-track calibrations for materially changed roles. Standard ladder cycles continue for others. File regrade requests flagged "reorg-impacted".
alina: any changes to on-call or pager expectations?
marco: no immediate increase to overall on-call frequency. we'll rebalance rosters and add temporary coverage if any team sees >20% pager increase.
alina: where will the updated org chart live?
people-bot: Org map v1: https://intranet.redwood.com/all-hands/updated-orgmap :link:
vp-people: org map tomorrow AM. managers get a CSV mapping and a short checklist. escalate mapping disputes to people-ops@redwood with subject "mapping-dispute".
alina: thanks all. i'll paste into the follow-up doc and flag any open items. :thumbsup:
